anaerobic_digestion.name: Anaerobic Digestion
anaerobic_digestion.description: Biological decomposition of organic matter in the absence of oxygen, producing biogas and digestate.

composting.name: Composting
composting.description: Aerobic biological decomposition of organic matter to produce a soil amendment.

pyrolysis.name: Pyrolysis
pyrolysis.description: Thermal decomposition of organic material in the absence of oxygen, producing biochar, bio-oil, and syngas.

incineration.name: Incineration
incineration.description: Combustion of waste at high temperature with energy recovery.
